subject: LIBA
title: Introduction to Liberal Arts
description: An introduction to the compass and significance of a Liberal Arts education, focusing on contemporary developments and challenges in the humanities. It considers the contribution of a range of disciplines and approaches across a wide range of linguistic traditions, geographical areas and time periods and pays particular attention to the global dimension of contemporary humanistic culture.

restrictions.text: Only open to students in the Liberal Arts program.

subject: LIBA
title: Individual Reading Course
description: Individual reading course in any topic pertinent to Liberal Arts as approved by the Director of the Liberal Arts program.

prerequisites.text: LIBA 202: Introduction to Liberal Arts Minimum Grade or Test Scores : C

restrictions.text: Registration in this course is subject to the approval of the Director of the Liberal Arts Program.
